text:
Hi, I’m Mina Castellan. I have 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboards, data cleaning, and data visualization.

In a Marketing attribution analysis for Verdant Skincare, I built a model in BigQuery and Looker Studio that joined ad spend with GA4 sessions to compare first-click, last-click, and position-based credit; it helped reallocate 18% of ad budget and lowered CAC by 12% the next quarter. In a Subscription churn cohorts project, I built monthly retention curves by signup cohort and plan plus an onboarding funnel; one step was linked to 40% of first-month churn.

For your HubSpot pipeline, I can help with setup logistics, data import, limited data entry, and structuring it so relationships between multiple customers/prospects are trackable in HubSpot Professional. Do you already have your current contacts and companies organized for import, or do you need help mapping those relationships first?
